resources.string: A calmer way to meet people nearby — built for genuine connection.
Verbinde dich mit Menschen, die deine einzigartige Perspektive schätzen – in deinem eigenen Tempo.

SpectRoom ist derzeit im Early Access und völlig kostenlos. Als frühes Mitglied hilfst du uns, eine bessere Community aufzubauen! Standardfunktionen bleiben kostenlos, optionale bezahlte Stufen kommen später
Füge Interessen und sensorische Vorlieben zu deinem Profil hinzu. So sehen andere, was dir wichtig ist und wie Interaktion leichtfällt.
Durchstöbere bis zu 10 Profile am Tag in deinem Tempo. Tippe oder wische nach rechts, wenn du eine Verbindung spürst - oder lass es ohne Unbehagen bleiben.
Verbinde dich per Direktnachricht mit eingebauten Tools, die den Start und das Tempo von Gesprächen angenehm machen.

SpectRoom is a dating and connection app thoughtfully designed for autistic adults and the broader neurodivergent community.
We believe that everyone deserves a space where communication styles are understood, sensory needs are respected, and individuality is celebrated - without judgment, pressure, or misunderstanding.
SpectRoom focuses on clarity, safety, and comfort.

Our design considers the unique needs of neurodivergent users, such as reduced sensory overload, structured communication, clear boundaries, and personalized support settings. Whether you\'re seeking friendship, dating, or deeper relationships, SpectRoom offers a calm and supportive environment where you can express yourself at your own pace.
Create a meaningful, inclusive space where neurodivergent people can connect authentically - and feel safe while doing so.
SpectRoom is built with respect, empathy, and accessibility at its core.
Abashelari Productions is an independent technology and creative development studio based in Stockholm.

We specialize in crafting thoughtful digital experiences with a focus on accessibility, education, and everyday empowerment. Our work spans mobile apps, interactive tools, and content designed to make life easier, more inclusive, and more enjoyable for users of all backgrounds.
Founded on a passion for innovation and human-centered design, Abashelari Productions develops products that combine technical reliability with emotional intelligence.
We believe in building software that respects users, simplifies complex challenges, and brings real value to people\'s lives.
From children\'s educational games to community-driven platforms like SpectRoom, our goal is to create meaningful digital products that leave a positive impact - one app at a time.
